SRC-CG source samples

These are saved source samples for deterministic tests, never production fallback data.

- Congress.gov: `congress-bill.json`, `congress-committees.json`, and `congress-text.json` are the Library of Congress's JSON examples (outside-string whitespace normalized) for bill 117/HR/21 from [its API repository](https://github.com/LibraryOfCongress/api.congress.gov/tree/main/api_client/java/sample_output), acquired October 12, 2026. Their `request` fields identify the original API routes.
- govinfo: `govinfo-collection.json` and `govinfo-summary.json` are GPO's original [collection and package examples](https://github.com/usgpo/api/tree/main/samples). `govinfo-bill-text.txt` is the contiguous excerpt returned by the web reader from [GPO's introduced H.R. 21 text](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/BILLS-117hr21ih/html/BILLS-117hr21ih.htm), acquired October 12, 2026. The excerpt is not a complete bill-text acquisition; production reads the provider's complete response.
- Federal Register: `federal-register.json` is the JSON listing returned by [the public API](https://www.federalregister.gov/api/v1/documents.json?per_page=1), acquired October 12, 2026 through the web reader. JSON string line breaks were escaped and the response was pretty-printed. The API returned 20 entries, including the next day's published metadata, despite the requested page size. Tests do not treat future publication dates as an open comment period.
- Senate LDA: `lda-contribution.json` and `lda-list.json` are original Senate API response bodies from [captured HTTP cassettes](https://github.com/christopherkenny/lobby/tree/main/tests/testthat/_vcr), recorded December 8, 2025. The individual report attests no contributions; the list has 25 real filings with contribution items. Individual donor names and filed addresses remain only in saved source bytes; the reader projection excludes them. LDA honorees carry no Bioguide IDs. They resolve through exact published name forms plus any stated chamber/state against the held federal roster, and only a single person may join. Missing chamber/state come from that unique roster person; donor location never supplies them. Every other row remains held and reported with its join reason.
- Regulations.gov: `regulations-openapi.yaml` is [GSA's published v4 API specification](https://github.com/GSA/open-gsa-redesign/blob/master/_apidocs/regulationsgov/v4/openapi.yaml), acquired October 12, 2026. `regulations-gov-live.json` is an authenticated v4 document page from the live API. Pagination-limit, deadline-change, withdrawal, and cross-provider transport cases remain explicitly controlled cases in the tests, separate from acquired government facts.

`congress-api-live.json`, `govinfo-live.json`, `federal-register-live.json`, `regulations-gov-live.json`, and `senate-lda-live.json` are real API responses acquired October 12, 2026 through the workspace's configured proxy with existing keys. The source-client smoke checks reached all five publishers. Regulations.gov rejected a page size of 1 with HTTP 400; the production page size of 250 succeeded. No credentials are committed. Production row totals and three live-state examples are deferred until River releases, exactly as requested in the READY commit.

`lda-honorees.json` contains four unchanged complete filing objects (464 contribution items), extracted from real authenticated [LDA contribution pages](https://lda.gov/api/v1/contributions/) read October 13, 2026 UTC (October 12 Eastern). Each sample records its acquisition URL and date. Real honorees include `Sen. John Cornyn (R-TX)`, `Rep. French Hill`, `Sen. Charles E. Schumer`, `Sen. Charles E. Grassley`, and `Sen. Bernie Sanders`. Other items include organizations and lists of several honorees, which must not be attributed to a member by selecting a name out of the string. Controlled corrections and duplicate-person ambiguity cases are explicitly separate test inputs.

`federal-roster.yaml` is the complete [congress-legislators current file at d5af3d2d2490f8c6532c9490b1f47a76cacca699](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unitedstates/congress-legislators/d5af3d2d2490f8c6532c9490b1f47a76cacca699/legislators-current.yaml), read October 13, 2026 UTC. Tests promote it through the existing federal-directory contract. Nicknames come only from its published `nickname` field or quoted annotations. The source's given, middle and family fields provide exact alternative forms; `J. French Hill` also permits its annotated given initial to be omitted. Conflicting middle initials, chamber/state conflicts, missing names, and multiple matching people stay unjoined. Join evidence references the immutable promoted roster version rather than copying the national roster into each filing; both the LDA filing and roster appear in the card's single Sources list and Ask evidence.

The current [LDA API specification](https://lda.gov/api/openapi/v1/) limits pages to 25 reports and requires a query filter beyond page one. National backfill uses the posting-date range from 2008, then follows the provider's next links. The `lda2` cursor reopens old SRC-CG cursors once to fill honoree joins, retains the original backfill watermark on resume, and rechecks historical joins when the roster's names, chamber or state change. Unchanged roster captures keep the incremental clock.
